Roguehalla region atmosphere audio (streamed from StreamingAssets/Audio, not part of the first-load data)

All files were converted to OGG Vorbis, trimmed where long, given an equal-power loop crossfade at the seam and loudness normalised
(music -17 LUFS, ambience -26 LUFS). Source files were not otherwise altered.

MUSIC

                     Licence elected from the page's list (CC-BY 3.0). Credit required: this notice. Trimmed to 110 s.
